# Summary

Explain the problem, the chosen approach, and the observable result.

## Changes

- List the important code, API, generated-file, test, and documentation changes.
- Keep unrelated changes out of this pull request.

## Validation

List the exact commands and manual scenarios used to validate the change.

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Ran relevant unit and integration tests.
- [ ] Ran formatting and static checks.
- [ ] Regenerated and reviewed checked-in artifacts, when applicable.
- [ ] Updated documentation, when applicable.

## Protocol and compatibility

Describe any effect on protobuf or gRPC APIs, wire compatibility, group or
account state, stored data, migrations, mobile bindings, and downstream
clients. Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Networking and privacy

Describe any effect on discovery, dialing, transports, relays, routing,
encryption, identity, metadata exposure, telemetry, or external services.
Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Risks and rollback

Describe important failure modes, operational considerations, and how the
change can be safely reverted or disabled.

## Related work

Link related issues, design documents, specifications, or dependent pull
requests.
